pitch: C at a1 = 415; B (natural) at a1 = 440; B-flat at a1 = 465.
dimensions: total sounding length 2584, be 133, bo 9.8 (not original), bell metal thickness just above garland 0.22 (ave.).
remarks: The instrument once belonged to Eggiman’s father, Hans Minder, of Huttwil. The Huttwil church used trombones until 1805, when an organ was built. Restored by Fritz Burri of Bern ca. 2007; inner slide tubes replaced. Major repair in bell section. Ferrules engraved with rings in pairs or threes. Bell bow and slide bow saddles, and saddle at one end of bell stay, have simple “rockered design” (Couper 2010). Bell-stay is round soldered tube. Bell-bow and slide-bow have no ring. Replacement tube (83mm) between bell flare and bell-stay. Bell-rim has semicircular bezel wire soldered around rim on the outer side in Nuremberg style, but another, smaller, semicircular wire is also soldered around the rim on the inner side of the bell flare (Couper 2010). Bell seam has rectangular tabs.
